target: Explain whether the rising B image-derived empty-area statistic reflects formation of internal RNA-poor domains, and identify a composition-dependent mechanism that could produce such domains.
known_relations: Reported B statistic rises from 0.01381 at 0 h to 0.08918 at 24 h; A falls from 0.01487 to 0.00446 (initial_measurements.json). This is an association with condition, not a causal effect of amplification.

C03 t=0 definition check: reported value equals arithmetic mean of per-object area ratios, not total dark area divided by total filled area. case_brief.md describes the latter; C03 did not check reserved late-time values.

Gel-purified length fractions differ at endpoint: M median field mean 0.000028, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412 (fraction_dev.json). This is one preparation with no exact mixture, RNA yield, time course, or matched carryover control.

C01 gives 94.66% reference DNA reads; listed non-reference reads sum to 5.00%, and total listed reads are 99.66%. Read frequencies do not establish transcript abundance, RNA composition, or active valence.

C04 shows bulk dense/dilute partition ratios vary across tie-lines and species (reference K about 239-525 on nonzero tie-lines; variant K about 176-9032). Propagated marginal-error ranges are broad; tie-line 0 variant ratio is undefined. These are not cavity-local measurements or a B time series.
C02 gives time-only extrapolations: B exponential 36/48 h 0.12072/0.15632; B linear 0.12387/0.16352. No preparation-level prediction interval; these are descriptive and do not explain mechanism.

B1-S2_S3 (2021-02-08; abstract only) reports ternary PLP/RRP/RNA competition producing PLP-rich and RRP-RNA phases, with engulfment morphology depending on RNA:RRP stoichiometry and interaction hierarchy. This is protein-RNA organization, not evidence for RNA-RNA demixing.
B1-S2_S5 (2021-06-16; abstract only) reviews internal architectures in dynamic/reactive condensates but specifies no RNA-RNA mechanism, condition, or spatial composition signature.

B1-S2_S4 (2023-03-07; abstract only) reviews associative/segregative protein and nucleic-acid transitions without the needed RNA-RNA condition; B1-S2_S2 (2022-10-01; abstract only) discusses PAR versus RNA generally; B1-S2_S1 (2023-01-25; abstract only) reports crowder-driven phase-boundary crossing in a model protein condensate while internal molecular arrangement is relatively insensitive. None directly tests H1.

B1-S3 returned five abstracts from 385 hits; only those five abstracts were assessed. S1 (2025-01-16) discusses site-specific and chemically specific determinants of condensate composition; S2 (2025-03-13) concerns protein-polyelectrolyte interactions; S3 (2025-03-31) gives broad protein/nucleic-acid LLPS context; S4 (2025-05-03) lists multiphases as a research frontier; S5 (2025-03-25) concerns condensate mechanics. None directly establishes RNA-RNA internal demixing or a cavity mapping.

hypotheses.status: selected as a new, provisional, unverified mechanism hypothesis; not established as the explanation of the observed cavities
hypotheses.statement: New hypothesis H1: if reference-like and variant or length-class RNAs have sufficiently unfavorable mutual interactions within the same dense RNA phase, a local composition fluctuation can cross a demixing instability and form a compositionally distinct, RNA-poor internal domain. Continued transcription or redistribution could change its incidence over time, but the kinetic bridge and mapping of such a domain to a dark segmented cavity are separate untested hypotheses.
hypotheses.derived_consequence: Under the assumed dimensionless binary regular-solution free energy g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), differentiation gives g′=ln(phi/(1-phi))+chi(1-2phi) and g′′=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi. Local instability requires g′′<0, hence chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)]; at phi=0.5 the threshold is chi>2. This is an algebraic conditional consequence, not an empirical estimate.
hypotheses.evidence_update: Three relation-oriented searches returned abstract-level background and a protein-RNA multiphase analogy, but no direct RNA-RNA internal-demixing relation among the supplied abstracts. The hypothesis is therefore new and testable but speculative for this system.

gaps.description: No direct evidence that two RNA species or length classes demix within one relevant dense RNA phase, and no measurement showing that a local compositional domain is the segmented RNA-poor cavity. The searches returned only abstracts, including general condensate context and protein-RNA analogies.

C03 verifies arithmetic averaging of per-object ratios at t=0, while the case brief describes a pooled-area ratio. Later timepoint aggregation remains unchecked; the statistic must be resolved before interpreting population-level changes quantitatively.

equations: g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), 0<phi<1; assumed regular-solution model, not fitted.
g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local spinodal condition g''<0, equivalently chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)].
No supplied equation maps local composition/domain geometry to f(t), and no dynamic equation is closed.

parameters_ranges.chi: No empirical range. Conditional instability threshold is 1/[2phi(1-phi)] for 0<phi<1.
parameters_ranges.phi: 0<phi<1 by definition; actual local and mean compositions unknown.

initial_boundary_conditions: No spatial initial condition, boundary condition, production/transport rates, or local composition data supplied. The spinodal criterion assumes a homogeneous binary mixture with a small perturbation; it makes no kinetic prediction.
observation_mapping: A local RNA-poor domain would count as a cavity only if it appears dark under the imaging and segmentation protocol. C03 verifies the t=0 reported value as the arithmetic mean of object-level ratios; case_brief.md states a pooled-area ratio, and later timepoint mapping is unchecked. E04 concentrations are bulk phase measurements, not local cavity concentrations or image area fractions.
alternatives: Population or measurement selection changes which droplets contribute to f without composition-demixing within individual droplets; tracking does not contain same-droplet cavity area/state histories.
Amplification-associated carryover or another reaction condition changes transcription or morphology; no matched-carryover control exists.
A single dense phase with non-equilibrium production/transport gradients produces dark regions without equilibrium RNA-RNA demixing; spatial production and transport are unmeasured.

Environmental or crowder-like changes can move a phase boundary without changing internal molecular arrangement, as a distinct model-protein abstract suggests; transfer to this RNA system is not established.

A population or image-selection effect changes object inclusion or weights without a new internal phase; this predicts no necessary within-droplet RNA-species ratio contrast between the dark region and adjacent dense material.

A non-equilibrium transcription or transport gradient creates dark regions within one dense phase; it need not produce the equilibrium demixing threshold or a stable two-species partition predicted by H1.
predictions: Discriminating prediction for H1: in the same droplets, cavity interiors and adjacent dense material show a reproducible difference in reference:variant or length-class RNA ratio, and a controlled change in RNA-class mixture at matched total RNA and reaction conditions changes cavity occurrence or morphology. Population selection can change f without a within-droplet species-ratio contrast. This prediction is not observed in the supplied data.
Population/measurement selection does not require a within-droplet species-ratio contrast; f may change through inclusion or object weighting.
Bulk E04 tie-lines cannot distinguish H1 from the alternatives.

next_task.summary: Selected candidate H1 is a new, conditional mechanism hypothesis: sufficiently unfavorable interactions between two RNA classes could destabilize a homogeneous dense phase and create a compositionally distinct RNA-poor internal domain. For the assumed binary regular-solution model, g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), differentiation yields g′′=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi and local instability when chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)] (chi>2 at phi=0.5). This is a model consequence only; no compute tool ran and neither phi nor chi is measured. B1-S1_S4 supports composition-dependent spatial organization in a ternary protein/protein/RNA system; B1-S2 and B1-S3 returns are abstract-level general context, not direct RNA-RNA support. The B field statistic rises 0.01381 to 0.08918 from 0 to 24 h while A falls 0.01487 to 0.00446, but the condition does not isolate cause and C03 resolves the statistic definition only at t=0. E02 endpoint fractions, E04 bulk phase concentrations, DNA reads, and mobility summaries do not measure cavity-local RNA composition. H1 is selected as a testable candidate, not a confirmed explanation.
candidates: A future experiment should measure species-specific RNA signal in cavity interiors and adjacent dense material within the same droplets over time, while varying RNA-class mixture at matched total RNA and transcription conditions. Record object-level and pooled-area definitions in parallel and include matched carryover controls.

final.question_and_reason: Can composition-dependent demixing between reference-like and variant or length-class RNAs create a local RNA-poor domain in a transcribing dense RNA droplet? This is the concrete mechanism gap suggested by the fraction-dependent endpoint observations, but the existing data and retrieved sources do not establish it.
final.increment: A new conditional RNA-RNA demixing hypothesis with a dimensionless local-instability criterion and a within-droplet species-ratio prediction, explicitly separated from the protein-RNA literature analogy and population-selection alternative.
new_hypotheses: If unfavorable effective interactions between RNA classes exceed the spinodal threshold at the local composition, an initially homogeneous dense phase is locally unstable to composition fluctuations; an RNA-poor domain could then appear. Continued production or redistribution causing the observed time trend is a separate unverified hypothesis.
final.actual_derivation_or_computation: Algebraic derivation only: differentiating g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi) twice gives g=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi. Setting g<0 yields chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)]; at phi=0.5 this becomes chi>2. The criterion is dimensionless and conditional on the regular-solution model. No numerical computation, fit, or estimate of phi or chi was run or returned.
final.discriminating_prediction: If H1 holds, species-specific RNA imaging within the same droplet will show a reproducible reference:variant or length-class ratio contrast between cavity interior and adjacent dense material; controlled mixture changes at matched total RNA and transcription conditions will alter cavity frequency or morphology. Population selection can change the aggregate statistic without such a within-droplet contrast.
final.evidence_support_conflict_untested: Support: B rises from 0.01381 to 0.08918 from 0 to 24 h while A falls from 0.01487 to 0.00446; endpoint length-fraction values differ; bulk E04 indicates species-dependent phase partitioning on some tie-lines. Conflicts and limits: one preparation for fraction endpoints, no causal amplification control, DNA read fractions are not RNA abundance, E04 is bulk not local, and C03 confirms object-mean f only at t=0 despite the case brief pooled-area definition. Abstracts B1-S1_S4, B1-S2_S5, and B1-S3_S1-S5 do not directly establish RNA-RNA internal demixing or cavity identity.
final.decision: Retain B1-H1 as the selected provisional mechanism hypothesis and reject any claim that it is confirmed as the cause. The evidence is insufficient to decide between internal demixing, non-equilibrium gradients, carryover, and population or measurement selection.
final.dissent: Population or measurement selection remains a live explanation; the same-droplet time history and later-time statistic aggregation are unavailable. The literature returned in this run does not establish the specific RNA-RNA mechanism.
final.next_experiment: In a future controlled experiment, image two RNA classes with calibrated species-specific labels and compare their ratio inside segmented cavities with adjacent dense regions in the same droplets over time; vary mixture at matched total RNA and transcription conditions, with matched carryover controls. Record both object-mean and pooled-area empty fractions.
final.limitations: All returned literature evidence is abstract-only. The model is an assumed binary regular-solution approximation and does not include production, transport, or morphology. No local composition, calibrated intensity mapping, independent preparation-level time course, or new physical measurement is available. The current run provides no computation tool result.
